# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.82

This corrective release restores the normal **BlockBuddies** app and package ID.

## Fixed

- Restored the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Removed the separate `BlockBuddies Preview` package and label.
- Replaced temporary GitHub runner debug signing with one stable, reproducible test certificate for downloadable APK releases.
- Future APKs produced by this release workflow will use the same package ID and signing certificate, allowing normal in-place updates.
- Added automated checks for the package ID, app label, APK signature, and SHA-256 checksum.

## Included gameplay additions

- Blue, purple, and red light sabers with HUD blade controls.
- Hovering Void Orb pet.
- Shadow Oracle outfit.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.82.apk`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- `SIGNING-CERTIFICATE.txt`
- `APK-BADGING.txt`

## One-time installation requirement

The BlockBuddies app currently installed on your device was signed with an earlier certificate that is no longer available. Android will not permit any differently signed APK to replace it, even when the package ID and version are correct.

You must uninstall that older BlockBuddies installation once before installing v1.5.82. After v1.5.82 is installed, later releases created by this workflow will update the same main app normally without creating a separate app.

Uninstalling clears that installation's local app data unless it has been exported or backed up first.
